page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head "VITA" at the top, with the page number "2" printed at top left. No marginal notes. The word "suam" stands at the right below the last line as a catchword.

main_text.l: que ad res Theologicas, imprimis ad eam
tem in hoc studiorum genere non nihil
soris, coepit cogitare de ejuranda eorum,
Religione. Ex eo tempore in Peronii fa-
vixit aliquantisper, à quo postea cùm di-
xit. Sed ut Morinus modesti erat animi,
& ab omni fastu abhorrentis, relictâ non
tunc in Gallia, potissimum Parisiis cele-
berrima erat, nomen suum dedit. Con-
postea ab Urbano VIII, ob singularem

page.notes: The text is clear throughout. "Berullns" is transcribed as printed; it is probably a misprint for "Berullus", but the printed form is kept. The catchword "suam" is set at the right below the last line and is kept only in the bottom margin.
